actions.description: Source-backed review conclusions so far: R13 B explicitly assigns the missing state/comparator implementation in D2; the permitted no-build Release comparator filter reproduces 1 failed, 0 passed, 0 skipped at line 23. R14 A provides an explicit approved disposition for the dead rotation-table read; do not preserve the former UNKNOWN merely by repeating its source risk. R12 still changes the original 100000-cycle obligation to a measured later boundary. Active CPU translation units include 6510dtvcore.c, whose DO_INTERRUPT services pending IRQ/NMI before its exported-register trap; a trigger is therefore not a guarantee of the first boundary at the requested cycle. D1 trap mock controls need active-core ordering, not only a direct callback. All 22 inspected materialized source hashes match pinned Git blobs; fixture has 24 modules, expected clock/registers and DRIVE flags.
